name: Agent log
description: One agent run beside its recording: the model's name, a clock of the run's own time, a token counter and the run's messages and tool calls scrolling in, all keyed to the run's transcript in source seconds. The recording is sped up `speed`× at one constant speed: at the item's first frame the source is at srcAt, then srcAt + seconds × speed. The clock counts from runStart and stops at durationMs, where doneLabel appears.
author: Biliup

model.description: The big name at the top, e.g. the model.

speed.description: Source seconds per second on screen (the recording's speed-up). Default 1.

srcAt.description: Source seconds at the item's first frame. Default 0.

runStart.description: Source seconds where the run's clock starts. Default 0.

durationMs.description: The run's reported length: the clock stops there and doneLabel shows.

doneLabel.description: Shown in the accent colour once the clock stops, e.g. the result.

tokenLabel.description: Under the token count (a line break allowed).

size.description: The log's text size in px for a 470 px wide box (default 19).

lines.description: The log: each line appears at source second t. With tool, it's a tool call (the name in mono, then text); without, a message.

tokens.description: The running token count: cum from source second t (in time order).

lines.text: I'll start by reading the screen.
